newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cosmo's Sakai 110,000 bpd topper to restart Monday.
newsitem.headline: Cosmo's Sakai 110,000 bpd topper to restart Monday.

text.p: Cosmo Oil Co Ltd said on Friday that its 110,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) at Sakai refinery in Osaka, western Japan, will be back on line on Monday.

The CDU has been shut since August 18 for routine maintenance checks, a company spokesman said. Cosmo Oil runs four refineries -- Chiba, Yokkaichi, Sakai, Sakaide -- with a total crude processing capacity of 645,000 bpd, 12 percent of Japan's refining capability.
